description: This file defines an interface IVersionSelector for selecting preferred grain interface versions and an abstract base class VersionSelectorStrategy for version selector strategies within Orleans. It includes method signatures without implementations and references external types such as ICompatibilityDirector.

classes.name: VersionSelectorStrategy
classes.description: Base class for all grain interface version selector strategy implementations.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns an array of suitable interface versions based on the requested version, available versions, and a compatibility director.
